title: William Field, M. P
html_source:
William Field (1843 – 1935) was an Irish butcher from Dublin, and a nationalist politician. From 1892 to 1918 he was Member of Parliament (MP) for Dublin St Patrick’s, taking his seat in the House of Commons of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland.
